snippet.title: Bastion Rivals – Official Gameplay Trailer | Coming Soon on Steam
snippet.description:
Build your army. Defend both lanes. Break the enemy bastion.

The new Bastion Rivals gameplay trailer: mixed armies, equipment, upgrades, siege warfare and rescue strikes.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5423790/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer&utm_campaign=launch_20261102&utm_content=official_trailer_r3
Target launch: 14 January 2027, subject to Steam build approval.

Official arranged gameplay, captured in the current native development build. Cannon insert uses native slow motion. Online modes are planned for launch.

Follow Bastion Rivals:
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@BastionRivals
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@bastionrivals
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61595385581181
X: https://x.com/BastionRivals

Music: Clash Defiant — Kevin MacLeod (edited/mixed). https://incompetech.com/
CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

#BastionRivals #RTS #StrategyGame #IndieGame #PCGaming
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bastionrivals/
IndieDB: https://www.indiedb.com/games/bastion-rivals
Game Jolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/bastion-rivals/1109252 Inspiration & thanks
Bastion Rivals is inspired by Castle Fight, the Warcraft III custom map originally created by geX (also known as gekko). Special thanks to geX and the Castle Fight community for the inspiration and years of castle battles.
